shortDescription: Robinhood Chain fee revenue has fallen 97% from its peak, according to CoinDesk. According to ChainCatcher, on-chain trading volume has not seen a major outflow and has remained at the tens of millions level, supported by lingering meme coin trading activity.

title: Robinhood Chain Fee Revenue Falls 97% From Peak as Meme Coin Trading Holds Volume
